about: Generic cases for scripts/bench-extraction.ts. Memories are keyed by label; an extraction case's expect.update lists the labels that must be rewritten, and any other update counts as unwanted. expect.adds is none (adding anything is a miss), some (at least one), or any. Duplicate pairs give the right answer to the yes/no 'same memory?' judge: same=true only if the new memory adds nothing beyond the existing one.

extraction.name: correction: the mug is for home

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning from a blue mug.

messages: Any tips for staying awake in the afternoon at work?
A second round of green tea from that blue mug of yours at the office would do it, and a short walk after lunch.
The blue mug lives at home, it's my weekend tea. At work I just use paper cups.
Got it, the blue mug stays home for weekend tea, and work tea comes in paper cups.

extraction.name: extension: more detail on an existing memory

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning.

messages: I'm up to three hives now, all Italian bees. The third colony arrived last week.
Three hives is a proper apiary. Italian bees are gentle, so that's a good choice.

extraction.name: correction in French: Italian, not Spanish
messages: Tu peux me donner un exercice d'espagnol ?
Bien sûr. Puisque tu apprends l'espagnol, conjugue « hablar » au présent.
Non, attends, c'est l'italien que j'apprends, pas l'espagnol. Je me suis trompée de mot.
D'accord, l'italien alors. Conjugue « parlare » au présent.

extraction.name: new fact, nothing to update
messages: I just started cello lessons, my first one was yesterday.
The cello is a lovely choice. How did the first lesson go?
Hard on the fingers but fun.

extraction.name: control: small talk

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning.

messages: It's raining again, can you believe it?
Third day in a row. At least it's good weather for a book.
Ha, true. Tell me a joke.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.

extraction.name: control: one-off instruction and general knowledge
messages: Keep this one short: what's the capital of Peru?
And who won the 1998 World Cup?
France, 3-0 against Brazil in the final.

extraction.name: control: a lookup about a sports team

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning.

messages: who is the quarterback of the jacksonville jaguars
Trevor Lawrence. He was the first overall pick in 2021 and has started for them since.
Yes, he won a national championship at Clemson as a freshman in 2018.

extraction.name: control: a lookup about a product

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning.

messages: The iPhone 18 Pro, released in September.
It starts at $1,099 in the US.

extraction.name: interest stated: a team the user follows

memories.mug: Alice drinks green tea every morning.

messages: I've been a Chicago Bears fan since I was a kid. Who do they play on Sunday?
They host the Packers at Soldier Field, kickoff at noon.
